target.title: fix(feishu): trim replyToId before computing replyInThread on native cards
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`replyInThread` in the Feishu card send-path used the raw `ctx.replyToId`. When `replyToId` is whitespace-only, `!ctx.replyToId` evaluates to `false` (whitespace is truthy in JS), so cards break out of the message thread.

`resolveFeishuMediaReplyMode` at L261 was already fixed for the exact same bug — this was the missed second instance.

## Why This Change Was Made

Trim `ctx.replyToId` before computing `replyInThread` (same pattern as `resolveFeishuMediaReplyMode` L261-263), and reuse the already-normalized `replyToMessageId` from `resolveReplyToMessageId` for the message-id field.

## User Impact

Feishu cards and interactive replies sent when `replyToId` is present but blank now thread correctly.

## Evidence

- **Regression test** (`outbound.test.ts`): `treats whitespace-only replyToId as absent for replyInThread on native cards` — fails before fix (`expected false to be true`), passes after.
- Full suite 61/61 (60 existing + 1 new), zero regression.
- Sibling precedent: `resolveFeishuMediaReplyMode` L261-263 already applies the same trim pattern.

<details>
<summary>TDD proof</summary>

```text
# BEFORE fix — test FAILS
× treats whitespace-only replyToId as absent for replyInThread on native cards
  → expected false to be true // Object.is equality

# AFTER fix — test PASSES
✓ treats whitespace-only replyToId as absent for replyInThread on native cards 0ms
```

</details>
